description: Task-B cyclic-vector intertwiner (handover §5) — Python reference correctness gate. Replaces the O(r⁴) vectorised null-space U in the gauge-aligned A-combiner with the O(r³) matrix-unit / cyclic-vector construction (no r²×r² matrix → clears the 4 r=64 λ⊢9 that OOM). Verified against the gauge-invariant combiner identity χ^λ(W·I·β) = Σ_μν Tr[A·(ρ_μ(W)⊗ρ_ν(β))] at 1e-25: H_6 all 11 λ⊢6, and H_9 λ=(8,1) (n_inner=6 path). Pins the reference for the Rust port.
